theme: Dark Mode Default (The Performance Pro & Retro-Futurism Hybrid)

typography.rules: Avoid Inter, Roboto, Open Sans. Use tight tracking for headings.

colors.strategy: High-contrast 'Tactical Minimalism'. Deep Obsidian anchor, Pure White for clarity, Electric Cyan for kinetic action.

visual_enhancers.surfaces: Use 'Glassmorphism' (Crystal variant) for floating controls: backdrop-blur-2xl bg-black/60 border border-white/10 shadow-[0_8px_32px_rgba(0,0,0,0.5)].
visual_enhancers.buttons: Pill-shaped, large touch targets (min 56px height). Primary actions get Electric Cyan background with solid Black text for max contrast.
visual_enhancers.ai_processing_state: Use the 'Tracing Beam' effect around the image container, plus a CSS repeating-linear-gradient scanline overlay to sell the 'Tech Launch AI' vibe.
visual_enhancers.shutter_effect: Full screen flash (bg-white opacity 1 to 0 over 300ms) on capture.

layouts.architecture: Mobile-first, fixed viewport (`h-screen overflow-hidden`). Content must not jump when address bar hides on mobile.
layouts.spacing: Generous spacing. Use safe-area-inset for iOS bottom bars. Padding `p-6` or `p-8` for panels.

views.attract_screen: Massive typography. Huge 'TAP TO START' area covering whole screen.
views.camera_view: Video feed fills screen (`object-cover absolute inset-0`). Floating controls in a glassmorphism dock at the bottom.
views.print_preview: Strict 3:2 (landscape) or 2:3 (portrait) aspect ratio container matching 4x6 print. Apply uploaded logo as absolute watermark.
views.gallery: Bento Grid Mode A (Tetris Grid) for recent creations. Asymmetric grid-cols-2.

motion.interactions: Framer Motion. whileTap={{ scale: 0.95 }}. Staggered entrances for gallery items.
motion.transitions: Use specific properties: `transition: transform 0.2s ease, opacity 0.2s ease`. NEVER use `transition: all`.

accessibility.contrast: Text over camera feeds MUST have a glassmorphism background or heavy drop-shadow.
accessibility.testing: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a `data-testid` attribute (e.g., `data-testid="shutter-btn"`).

media.icons_library: @phosphor-icons/react (Weight: duotone for UI, bold for primary actions)

component_instructions.camera_capture: Utilize HTML5 `getUserMedia`. Ensure `facingMode: 'user'` or `'environment'` toggles properly.
component_instructions.file_uploads: Hide native `<input type="file">`. Use a custom labeled dropzone/button with Phosphor icons.
component_instructions.modals_toasts: Use Shadcn Dialog but apply custom borders/glassmorphism. Use Sonner for all toast notifications (`import { Toaster, toast } from 'sonner'`).
component_instructions.print_functionality: Create a dedicated `@media print` CSS block. Hide EVERYTHING except the `.print-container` which holds the 4x6 image. Use `window.print()`.

demo_event_background.description: Tech launch audience. Use as fallback background for attract screen.

demo_company_logo.description: OpenAI minimal logo. Use to mock the persistent event logo watermark.

demo_caricature_1.description: Laughing woman. Mocking AI generated caricature in gallery.

demo_caricature_2.description: Laughing man BW. Mocking AI generated caricature in gallery.

UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: You MUST NOT apply universal transitions like `transition: all`. Only target specific properties.
Do not use generic centered layouts for complex screens. Use optical alignment.
Never use `transparent` backgrounds for headers/dropdowns that overlap content. Always use glassmorphism.
Never use placeholder image domains (e.g., via.placeholder.com). Use the provided image URLs.
Implement tactile micro-animations on ALL buttons.
Design files must use JS, not TSX. Follow standard React JSX syntax but inside .jsx or .js files.
